item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00225","case1_error":"Correct total-and-division formulas are followed by unsupported 6186; the correct result is 859.","case2_error":"Treats the $1000 commission as a base price and adds 20%, instead of dividing by the 20% commission rate.","reason":"The first supplies an unsupported number after correct formulas; the second explicitly uses an incorrect commission-to-price relation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00226","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 22 − 7/3 as 22 2/3 and reports yards when feet were requested.","case2_error":"Uses all 500 flowers as the rose count and again as the lily count, overcharging both categories.","reason":"The first combines a subtraction evaluation error with missing unit conversion; the second substitutes the combined count for each category's count.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00227","case1_error":"Models five children and five adults instead of three children and two adults.","case2_error":"Assigns the friend's 40% payment to John, whose share is the remaining 60%.","reason":"The first uses incorrect population counts in the cost equation; the second answers with the other person's share.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00228","case1_error":"Counts each two-dozen set as 12 cups, omitting the factor of two.","case2_error":"Incorrectly equates adult apples with three times remaining apples, then gives unsupported 110 after the correct final expression, which yields 40.","reason":"The first omits a stated group-size factor. The second contains a wrong intermediate relation and an unsupported final number despite a correct final formula.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00229","case1_error":"Writes an incorrectly grouped profit-per-mile expression and supplies unsupported $100; the correct trip-profit formula yields $180.","case2_error":"Treats the $2 price for five cans as a $2 price per can.","reason":"The first has a grouping error and unsupported final result; the second misinterprets a bundle price as a unit price.","judgment":"different"}]}
